title: Cast a Spell
subtitle: Use a spell with a 1-reaction cast time
description: Some spells, like Shield or Counterspell, have a casting time of 1 Reaction, allowing you to cast them in response to a specific event.

bullets.content: The trigger for the reaction is specified by the spell itself.

title: Opportunity Attack
subtitle: Strike a foe who moves away
description: You can make a melee attack against a creature that moves out of your reach, interrupting its movement.

bullets.content: The rules for this attack are as follows:

items: Trigger: An enemy you can see leaves your reach using its Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or Speed.
Reaction: Make one melee attack with a weapon or an unarmed strike against the provoking creature.
The attack occurs right before the creature leaves your reach.

bullets.content: This is one of the most common reactions in combat.

title: Readied Action
subtitle: Act on your chosen trigger
description: Execute the action you prepared using the Ready action on your turn.

bullets.content: The trigger and reaction are those that you specified when you took the Ready action.
